story.title: One man, four names
story.puzzle: A freight company at Port Ondrel buys from a marine supplier, pays a logistics consultant, holds a personal guarantee for a credit line and works through a licensed ship agent. Each desk checked its own file and found nothing wrong. The files hold 1,445 sheet rows and five scans.
story.twist: The supplier Adrian Kassar, the consultant A. Qassar, the guarantor Adrian Khassar and the ship agent أدريان قصار are one man, born on 2 March 1974. A marine surveyor named Adrian Kasar, born the same year, is someone else, and the rules cannot tell them apart.
